name: ai-assistant-ada-monorepo
description: Ada AI Assistant - 3D Holographic AI Companion (Monorepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,WEB,WORKER" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/worker"
scripts.dev:minimal: concurrently -n "SERVER,WEB" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/worker && npm run build -w apps/web
